metric_definitions.label: Savings Rate
metric_definitions.description: Generated savings or losses as a percent of the updated benchmark.

metric_definitions.label: Per-Capita Expenditure (Total PY)
metric_definitions.description: Total Medicare per-capita expenditure for assigned beneficiaries in the PY.

metric_definitions.label: Quality Score
metric_definitions.description: Composite ACO quality score used to determine the final shared-savings payment.

metric_definitions.label: CMS-HCC Risk Score (AGND, PY)
metric_definitions.description: CMS-HCC risk score for aged non-dual beneficiaries in the performance year.

metric_definitions.label: SNF Admits / 1000
metric_definitions.description: Skilled nursing facility admissions per 1,000 person-years.

metric_definitions.label: 30-day Readmission Risk-Std (Measure 479)
metric_definitions.description: All-cause unplanned admissions for patients with multiple chronic conditions.

metric_definitions.label: Dual-Eligible %
metric_definitions.description: Percent of assigned beneficiaries who are dual-eligible.

metric_definitions.label: Long-Term Institutionalized %
metric_definitions.description: Percent of assigned beneficiaries who are long-term institutionalized.

metric_definitions.label: Updated Benchmark / Beneficiary
metric_definitions.description: Per-capita updated benchmark used for the performance year.

metric_definitions.label: Assigned Beneficiaries
metric_definitions.description: Total number of assigned Medicare FFS beneficiaries.

metric_definitions.label: Final Share Rate
metric_definitions.description: Percentage of generated savings the ACO is eligible to keep.

metric_definitions.label: Risk Score Ratio (BY3 → PY)
metric_definitions.description: Membership-weighted CMS-HCC risk score in the performance year divided by the membership-weighted risk score in benchmark year 3. Above 1.00 means documented risk grew relative to the benchmark period.

metric_definitions.label: Medical Expense Trend (BY3 → PY)
metric_definitions.description: Membership-weighted per-capita expenditure in the performance year divided by the membership-weighted per-capita expenditure in benchmark year 3. Below 1.00 means per-capita cost fell relative to the benchmark period.

metric_definitions.label: Final Benchmark Adjustment / Beneficiary
metric_definitions.description: The benchmark adjustment CMS actually applied — the regional adjustment or the prior savings adjustment, whichever CMS selected (per FinalAdjCat). Higher raises the benchmark.

metric_definitions.label: Regional Adjustment / Beneficiary
metric_definitions.description: Regional efficiency adjustment to the benchmark, before CMS selects between it and the prior savings adjustment.

metric_definitions.label: Prior Savings Adjustment / Beneficiary
metric_definitions.description: Credit for past program performance, before CMS selects between it and the regional adjustment.

quality_measures.label: Diabetes: HbA1c Poor Control (>9%)
quality_measures.description: Percent of diabetic patients whose most recent HbA1c was greater than 9% or missing. An inverse measure — lower is better.

quality_measures.label: Controlling High Blood Pressure
quality_measures.description: Percent of hypertensive patients whose blood pressure was adequately controlled.

quality_measures.label: Screening for Depression and Follow-Up Plan
quality_measures.description: Percent of patients screened for depression with a documented follow-up plan.

quality_measures.label: Depression Remission at Twelve Months
quality_measures.description: Percent of patients with depression who reached remission at twelve months.

quality_measures.label: Falls: Screening for Future Fall Risk
quality_measures.description: Percent of patients aged 65+ screened for future fall risk.

quality_measures.label: Preventive Care: Influenza Immunization
quality_measures.description: Percent of patients who received an influenza immunization.

quality_measures.label: Tobacco Use: Screening and Cessation Intervention
quality_measures.description: Percent of patients screened for tobacco use who received cessation intervention if needed.

quality_measures.label: Breast Cancer Screening
quality_measures.description: Percent of women aged 50-74 screened for breast cancer.

quality_measures.label: Colorectal Cancer Screening
quality_measures.description: Percent of patients aged 45-75 screened for colorectal cancer.

quality_measures.label: Statin Therapy for CVD Prevention/Treatment
quality_measures.description: Percent of eligible patients prescribed or on statin therapy.

quality_measures.label: All-Cause Unplanned Readmission (HWR)
quality_measures.description: Risk-standardized, hospital-wide, 30-day all-cause unplanned readmission rate. An inverse measure — lower is better.

quality_measures.label: Admissions for Patients with Multiple Chronic Conditions
quality_measures.description: Risk-standardized acute admission rate for patients with multiple chronic conditions. An inverse measure — lower is better.

methodology.risk_ratio_by3_py: Membership-weighted PY CMS-HCC risk score divided by membership-weighted BY3 risk score. PY weights use the published RR_weight_* fields; BY3 weights are derived from N_AB_Year_*_BY3 person-years because CMS does not publish RR_weight_*_BY3. Segments missing a score or a weight are excluded from both numerator and denominator.
methodology.expense_trend_by3_py: Membership-weighted PY per-capita expenditure divided by membership-weighted BY3 per-capita expenditure, using Per_Capita_Exp_ALL_* weighted by N_AB_Year_* person-years for the matching period.
methodology.final_adj: If FinalAdjCat is a Regional Adjustment, FinalAdj = RegAdj. If it is a Prior Savings Adjustment, FinalAdj = PriorSavAdj. Otherwise 0.
methodology.quality_coalescing: Measures reported through multiple mechanisms (Web Interface, eCQM, MIPS CQM, Medicare CQM) are coalesced to a single value; each ACO reports through one.
methodology.inverse_measures: HbA1c poor control, readmissions, and MCC admission rates are inverse: a lower value is better performance. Percentile ranks are reported on the raw value; presentation layers invert the language.
methodology.regional_peers: Peer set = all ACOs sharing at least one service-area state, from the PY2024 ACO Participants file. Ranks are computed exactly from peer raw values.
